name: Title-case a sentence
instruction: Implement titleCase(s) in titlecase.js: words are separated by single spaces; for each word, uppercase the first character and lowercase the rest; join with single spaces. E.g. 'the QUICK brown' -> 'The Quick Brown'; '' -> ''; 'a' -> 'A'. Keep the CommonJS export shape.
verifyCmd: node -e "const f=require('./titlecase.js'); if(f('hello world')!=='Hello World')process.exit(1); if(f('the QUICK brown')!=='The Quick Brown')process.exit(1); if(f('')!=='')process.exit(1); if(f('a')!=='A')process.exit(1); console.log('ok')"
